info.name: EPC QR Code Generator
info.summary: Generate EPC/SEPA QR codes for bank transfers
info.description:
# EPC QR Code Generator
Generate **EPC/SEPA QR codes** for European bank transfers directly inside Nextcloud. Scan the code with any SEPA-compatible banking app to pre-fill a transfer — no manual typing of IBANs or amounts.
## Features
- **EPC/SEPA standard** — produces valid GIROCODE / EPC QR codes recognised by European banking apps - **Live preview** — QR updates instantly as you type - **Full customization** — pixel colors and shapes, finder pattern styles, background color - **Logo embedding** — drop your organisation logo in the center (square, round, or original shape; stretch or crop fit) - **Transaction text** — optional caption below the QR (beneficiary, IBAN, amount) with custom font and size - **Presets** — save and reload your favourite styles - **History** — every generated code is kept for quick re-use - **Export** — download as PNG, copy to clipboard, or save straight to Nextcloud Files
## Use cases
Donations, invoices, membership fees, event payments — anywhere you want people to pay you without copying bank details by hand.
IBAN is validated (modulo-97) before generation. All processing happens client-side; no transaction data leaves your server.
